settings.title: Settings
settings.extensionsCoreDescription: Built-in extensions you can enable or disable.
settings.extensionsNone: No extensions are available in this build.
settings.composerModeDescription: Choose whether composing opens in the main window or a separate window
settings.mailtoModeDescription: Choose how mailto links from other apps are handled
settings.composerFormatDescription: New messages will use this format by default. You can still switch per message.
settings.undoSendDelayDescription: How long a sent message waits in the Outbox before it goes out. During the wait you can undo it from the countdown or the Outbox — after that the mail is gone and cannot be recalled.
settings.defaultCcHelp: Automatically added to the CC field when composing from an enabled account.
settings.defaultBccHelp: Automatically added to the BCC field when composing from an enabled account.
settings.defaultReplyToHelp: Sets the Reply-To address for messages composed from an enabled account.

settingsCategories.defaultTabHelp: Which tab the Inbox and Unified Inbox open on. All shows everything; Personal and Automated only show mail filed under that tab. Nothing is hidden permanently — switching tabs is one click.
settingsCategories.overridesHelp: Senders you corrected with “Always treat mail from this sender as…”. A rule beats every other signal, for all future mail from that sender. Removing a rule returns future mail to the automatic filing; mail already filed keeps its tab until it is reclassified.
settingsCategories.overridesEmpty: No sender rules yet. Right-click a message to add one.
settingsCategories.backfillRemaining: {count} messages have not been classified yet.
settingsCategories.backfillDone: All synced mail has been classified.
settingsCategories.failedToRemoveOverride: Could not remove the sender rule

settingsGeneral.titleBarHelp: Choose the title bar style (native requires restart)
settingsGeneral.titleBarNativeDesc: Use the OS native title bar (Restart Required)
settingsGeneral.windowControlsHelp: Where the minimize, maximize and close buttons appear in the Daak title bar. Auto follows your operating system and desktop environment.
settingsGeneral.themeHelp: Choose light, dark, or follow system preference
settingsGeneral.messageListDensityHelp: Adjust the spacing and text size in the message list
settingsGeneral.showMessageListCircles: Show colored circles in message list
settingsGeneral.showMessageListCirclesHelp: Show colored circles with sender initials in the message list
settingsGeneral.showViewerCircles: Show colored circles in conversation viewer
settingsGeneral.showViewerCirclesHelp: Show colored circles with sender initials in the conversation viewer
settingsGeneral.showMessageListProfilePics: Show contact photos in message list
settingsGeneral.showMessageListProfilePicsHelp: Show the contact's profile picture (falling back to a colored circle) in the message list. Requires "Show colored circles in message list".
settingsGeneral.accentBarUnreadHelp: Shows an accent on the left side of unread messages for easier identification.
settingsGeneral.darkMailContentHelp: Apply a dark filter to email message content when Daak is in dark mode.
settingsGeneral.darkComposerBodyHelp: Use a dark background for the composer message body when Daak is in dark mode.
settingsGeneral.alwaysShowCheckbox: Always show checkbox next to message
settingsGeneral.alwaysShowCheckboxHelp: Reserve a fixed checkbox column in the message list instead of revealing it on hover or swipe.
settingsGeneral.showMessagePreviewPaneHelp: Show the message preview beside the message list. When off, the list fills the window and messages open in the mode chosen below — double-click or press Enter to open.
settingsGeneral.hideUnifiedSingleAccount: Hide the Unified section with a single account
settingsGeneral.hideUnifiedSingleAccountHelp: When there is only one account, hide the Unified section at the top of the sidebar. That account's folders still show below.
settingsGeneral.messageOpenMode: When the preview pane is off, open messages in
settingsGeneral.messageOpenModeHelp: How a message opens when the preview pane is off. Dialog opens the message in a large dialog, popup window in a separate window. You can move an open message between tab, dialog and popup window from the view switcher in its header.
settingsGeneral.readReceiptPolicy: When someone requests a read receipt
settingsGeneral.readReceiptPolicyHelp: Read receipts notify the sender when you've read their message
settingsGeneral.markAsReadHelp: -1 = manual only, 0 = immediate, 0.1-5 = delay in seconds
settingsGeneral.runInBackgroundHelp: Keep Daak running when the window is closed
settingsGeneral.showUnreadBadge: Show unread badge on app and tray icons
settingsGeneral.showUnreadBadgeHelp: Show the unread count on the Dock or taskbar icon and the tray icon
settingsGeneral.autostartHelp: Automatically start Daak when you log in
settingsGeneral.restartRequiredDescription: The title bar change will take effect after restarting Daak.
settingsGeneral.alwaysLoadImagesHelp: Disables image blocking for all emails. Remote images will load automatically.
settingsGeneral.alwaysLoadImagesWarningDescription: Loading remote images automatically can expose your IP address, confirm when you read an email, and allow tracking by senders. Are you sure you want to disable image blocking?

account.addDescription: Connect your email account to start receiving messages.
account.editDescription: Manage your email account settings, identities, and signatures.
account.colorHelp: Color is used to identify this account in unified inbox
account.displayNameHelp: Name shown to email recipients (can be customized per email address in Identity tab)
account.customOAuthHelp: Use your own OAuth app. Enter your provider's issuer URL and Daak discovers the endpoints automatically.
account.customOAuthIssuerHelp: Your provider's base URL. Daak reads its /.well-known/openid-configuration document.
account.customOAuthClientSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank for a public client (PKCE)
account.customOAuthScopesHelp: Space-separated. Most servers need offline_access for a refresh token.
account.customOAuthRedirectUriHelp: Register this in your OAuth app using regex/pattern matching — the loopback port is assigned dynamically at sign-in (RFC 8252).
account.manageFolderSyncHelp: When enabled, choose which folders sync automatically. When disabled, only Inbox, Drafts, and Sent are synced.
account.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {name} ({email})?
account.deleteWarning: This will permanently remove all local messages, folders, and settings for this account. Your emails on the server will not be affected.
account.chooseProviderHelp: Select your provider for automatic configuration
account.syncPeriodHelp: How far back to sync messages
account.checkNewMailHelp: How often to check for new messages (IDLE push is also used when available)
account.requestReadReceiptsHelp: When to request read receipts for outgoing messages
account.folderMappingHelp2: Map folder types to specific IMAP folders on your server.
account.redirectToSignIn: You'll be redirected to sign in securely
account.notesGoogle: Sign in with Google or use an App Password
account.notesFastmail: Use App Password from Settings > Privacy & Security
account.oauthFreshToken: Your account has a fresh OAuth token
account.reauthorizeHelp: If you're having sync issues, try re-authorizing to get a fresh token
account.signInAgainHelp: Sign in again to refresh credentials if needed

account.noOutgoingServerHelp: Disables sending for this account. The address won't appear in the composer's From dropdown. Replies on messages received here use your selected identity or default sending account.
account.replyForwardWithHelp: Identity to pre-select in the composer when replying to or forwarding messages received here.
account.smtpCredsNote: If you set a different username and password for SMTP, you can modify it in the "SMTP authentication" section in the "Server" tab.
account.trustedCertsHelp: Manually trusted TLS certificates for this account's servers.
account.noTrustedCerts: No manually trusted certificates for this account's servers.
account.removeTrustedCertDescription: This certificate will no longer be trusted. Future connections to this server may require you to accept the certificate again.

identity.plainTextHelp: Used when sending plain text emails
identity.sharedMailboxesHelp: Add Microsoft 365 shared mailboxes you have access to.

images.noAddresses: No addresses in the allowlist. Use "Always Load > For sender" in the email viewer to add addresses.
images.noDomains: No domains in the allowlist. Use "Always Load > For domain" in the email viewer to add domains.

writeAccessPicker.title: Enable write access
writeAccessPicker.description: Choose the {provider} account to authorize for write access on {sourceName}.
writeAccessPicker.emptyHint: Add a {provider} account in Mail (Settings → Accounts) or Contacts (Settings → Contacts → Add source) first, then return here.

chip.codeClickHint: Click to copy the code. By default the message is marked read and moved to Trash.

settingsMessages.codeChipClickHelp: What happens when you click a verification code chip in the message list or viewer. The code is always copied to the clipboard first.
settingsMessages.otpClearSeconds: Clear copied code from clipboard after (seconds)
settingsMessages.otpClearSecondsHelp: Daak clears a copied code from the clipboard after this many seconds, but only if the clipboard still holds that code. 0 means never.

settingsAttention.enabledHelp: Surface important mail — verification codes, travel changes, payment failures and delivery problems — as bars above the message list.
settingsAttention.typeVerificationCodeHelp: A verification code arrived in the last 24 hours.
settingsAttention.typeFlightChangedHelp: A flight, hotel or booking was cancelled, rescheduled or delayed.
settingsAttention.typePaymentFailedHelp: A payment failed, was declined, or is overdue.
settingsAttention.typeDeliveryProblemHelp: A delivery ran into a problem, such as a failed delivery or customs hold.

settingsTranslation.enabled: Offer translation for messages in other languages
settingsTranslation.enabledHelp: Detect the language of each message as you read it and offer to translate it. Nothing is translated until you press Translate.
settingsTranslation.modeHelp: Prefer offline tries the on-device engine and downloaded models first, and only offers online translation as a separate choice. Offline only never sends text anywhere. Online goes straight to the online provider.
settingsTranslation.targetHelp: Messages in other languages are offered in this language. System language follows the app language.
settingsTranslation.onlineProviderHelp: Used only when you choose online translation. Google Translate needs no key; DeepL needs your own API key.
settingsTranslation.deeplKeySet: Key saved — enter a new key to replace it
settingsTranslation.deeplKeyHelp: Stored in the system keyring where available, otherwise encrypted in the database. Free keys end in :fx and use the free DeepL endpoint.
settingsTranslation.consentHelp: Online translation sends the message text to the provider. Consent is asked once per provider, the first time you translate online, and can be taken back here.
settingsTranslation.consentGoogleHelp: The message text will be sent to Google to translate.
settingsTranslation.consentDeepLHelp: The message text will be sent to DeepL to translate.
settingsTranslation.packsHelp: The offline engine and its language models are downloaded once from Mozilla and kept in the Daak data folder — nothing is bundled with the app. Only downloaded languages work offline; anything else uses the online provider or shows as unavailable offline.
settingsTranslation.packsEmpty: No offline language is available. Check the connection and try again.
settingsTranslation.catalogueFailed: Could not load the list of available languages. Check the connection and try again.
settingsTranslation.deleteFailed: Could not delete the language pack: {error}
settingsTranslation.engineHelp: The translation engine itself (about 5 MB). It downloads once, the first time you translate offline, and every offline language needs it.
settingsTranslation.engineDeleteFailed: Could not delete the offline engine: {error}
settingsTranslation.languagesHelp: Each language downloads both directions with English where both exist — about 40–70 MB per language. Only languages with an offline model are listed.
settingsTranslation.languagesLoading: Loading the list of available languages…
